why: A (no universe parameters; the defs sphMinPathsHomotopyEquiv / sphMinPathsHomeomorph read as Nonempty of their types; equator, semicircle, minPaths are vocabulary) lives on the project's embedded round sphere Sph (n+1) ⊆ ℝⁿ⁺² with the induced metric: every unbroken geodesic p → -p is a great circle with L = (2m+1)π, these circles are paths p → -p, E ≥ π² on Ω(p,-p), least-energy paths are great semicircles through the equator, u ↦ semicircle is d-continuous, and equator ≃ Ω^d up to homotopy / ≃ₜ its separation quotient. B: on every abstract Riemannian manifold M with an isometric ψ onto the unit sphere and any Levi-Civita connection, for ψ q = -ψ p: ρ(p,q)² = π², Ω^{π²} = the minimal geodesics (blind IsMinimal), and Ω^{π²} is identified with the equator by continuous Φ, Ψ with ΦΨ = id, ΨΦ = id on [0,1]. A ⇒ B fails genuinely (setting: transport along an abstract isometry ψ, naturality and uniqueness of the Levi-Civita connection are not formalized). B ⇒ A fails genuinely: B says nothing about non-minimal geodesics (A's list (1)), about the trivial membership (2), or about the specific semicircle map (5); on the embedded sphere B gives back all of A's other conjuncts.
overlap: B_to_A_B: 482 shared project theorems — great-circle computations (energy_greatCircle, speed_greatCircle, norm_greatCircle, isGeodesicOn_greatCircle, secondFundForm_sph), the geodesic ODE/uniqueness machinery under Morse.exists_eqOn_greatCircle and exists_initial_ray (the lemma behind A's (1), used by B_emb_to_A4 to classify the minimal geodesic B provides), Bridge/slice-chart infrastructure. A_core_to_B_emb: 555 shared — the same great-circle lemmas, PathSp metric lemmas, eventually_supDist_le_of_tendsto_apply (used by Sph.continuous_semi, a copy of the project's continuity proof), Hopf–Rinow infrastructure. Not shared by either: the substance of pi_sq_le_energy_sph (exists_brokenSetup_uniform, BrokenSetup.exists_energy_minimizing) and of exists_eqOn_semicircle (isUnbrokenGeodesic_of_minimal).
